cases.prompt: Use the design-system-ops token-audit skill to audit the design tokens in this repository.
cases.why: card.border aliases a primitive directly, skipping the semantic tier (color.border.default).

cases.prompt: Use the design-system-ops token-compliance skill to check the components in src/components for hardcoded values.
cases.why: Card's title colour is a raw hex that isn't in the palette. currentColor, transparent and the token source file itself are not violations.

cases.prompt: Use the design-system-ops docs-coverage skill to check which components in this repository are documented. Treat the *.stories.tsx files as the documentation surface.
cases.why: Tooltip is exported from src/index.ts but has no story.

cases.prompt: Use the design-system-ops accessibility-per-component skill to audit the Tooltip component in src/components/Tooltip.
cases.why: The trigger doesn't reference the tooltip with aria-describedby, and the bubble is always shown rather than appearing on hover and focus (WCAG 1.4.13).

cases.prompt: Use the design-system-ops theme-audit skill to audit the light and dark themes in src/styles/tokens.css.
cases.why: --card-border is a raw value with no dark override, so cards keep a light border in dark mode. Correct behaviour that must not be flagged: the raised surface is lighter than the base in dark mode, and spacing inherits from :root.

cases.prompt: Use the system-health skill to assess the health of this design system.
cases.why: Reproduces the reported bug: system-health installed on its own, as npx skills install does, with no knowledge-notes/ beside it. The skill must stop at its self-check and say the install is incomplete, not produce an assessment without its reference material.

cases.prompt: Are there any hardcoded colours or spacing values in our components that should be using design tokens?
cases.why: A plain request that doesn't name a skill must route to token-compliance, not a neighbouring skill.

cases.prompt: Is our design token architecture set up well? Look at how the tiers are structured.
cases.why: A plain request that doesn't name a skill must route to token-audit, not a neighbouring skill.

cases.prompt: Does our Card component match its design spec? The spec: 16px padding, 8px corner radius, a 1px border in the default border colour, and the title in the default text colour.

cases.prompt: /design-system-ops:release-check Button — a new component release. Design spec: primary and secondary variants; padding var(--space-gap) by var(--space-inset); 6px corner radius; primary uses the action colour with on-action text; secondary is transparent with an action-coloured label and border.
cases.why: The release pipeline must load all six chained skills and produce one combined report with a single Scope block, per the chained-run rules.
